text: どりょくは　ひとに　みせたく　ないじゃん

structure.jp: ひとに　みせたく　ないじゃん
structure.en: you don't want to show it to people, right?

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to', and たく　ない is 'don't want to'. みせたく　ない = 'don't want to show'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃないか at the end asks the listener to agree with something obvious. じゃん is the casual young-people form. みせたく　ないじゃん = 'you don't want to show it, do you?'.
